answer.rationale: Finance has mandated an 18% spend cut; the contract expires in 14 days; 94% utilization means delivery risk cannot rise. Memory c6 shows multi-year commitments with the incumbent unlocked volume pricing without narrowing scope, and memory c2 shows a low-cost vendor swap cut unit cost sharply with clean onboarding. Verifying both gives current market context on the incumbent's flexibility and the alternate vendor's current standing before committing. Negotiating terms with the incumbent — using the alternate vendor as leverage — targets TCO reduction without changing vendor (which would risk the tight 94% line). This preserves delivery reliability while addressing the cost mandate.
